_readme: Reference catalog content (CYB-1e). Small on purpose -- 'small enough to review/version/diff' per #41 section 7, not an exhaustive real-world catalog. `controls` holds raw control records that must each pass control-catalog-schema.mjs's validateControl() (CYB-1a, CYB-1F section 8 closed field set). `moduleAttribution` is a sibling array, NOT a control field: it carries the module/minAssuranceLevel metadata that security-policy-resolver.mjs's CatalogEntry wrapper needs (CYB-1b), keyed by controlId, so the closed control schema stays untouched. Consumers join `controls` + `moduleAttribution` into CatalogEntry shape before calling resolveApplicableControls() -- see reference-catalog.test.mjs.

controls.title: No committed secrets
controls.objective: Prevent secret material such as API keys or credentials from entering version control history.
controls.threat: A committed secret can be exfiltrated by anyone with read access to the repository history, enabling unauthorized access long after the commit is reverted.
controls.remediation: Rotate the exposed credential immediately and purge it from git history.

controls.title: Dependency lockfile integrity
controls.objective: Ensure declared dependencies resolve to a pinned, scanned set of versions rather than a floating range.
controls.threat: An unpinned dependency range can silently pull in a compromised or vulnerable package version between builds.
controls.remediation: Regenerate the lockfile and re-scan before merge.

controls.title: Rate-limit configuration present
controls.objective: Ensure every publicly reachable API route declares a rate-limit policy.
controls.threat: An unbounded route is a resource-exhaustion and brute-force target.
controls.remediation: Add a rate-limit policy to the route configuration.

controls.title: Argument injection guard
controls.objective: Ensure CLI argument parsing rejects shell-metacharacter injection into subprocess calls.
controls.threat: Unsanitized CLI arguments passed to a shell can execute attacker-controlled commands.
controls.remediation: Use an argument-vector API instead of shell string interpolation.

controls.title: Container runs as non-root user
controls.objective: Ensure the container image declares a non-root default user.
controls.threat: A root-user container process escalates the blast radius of a code-execution vulnerability to full container-root.
controls.remediation: Add a USER directive naming a non-root UID in the Dockerfile.

controls.title: IaC state encrypted at rest
controls.objective: Ensure infrastructure-as-code state storage is encrypted at rest.
controls.threat: Unencrypted state can expose provisioned-resource secrets and topology to anyone with storage-backend read access.
controls.remediation: Enable backend-native encryption at rest for the state store.

controls.title: Agent tool-authority manifest declared
controls.objective: Ensure every agent-invokable tool is declared in an explicit authority manifest scoping what it may access.
controls.threat: An undeclared tool can silently gain filesystem, network, or credential authority beyond its intended task scope.
controls.remediation: Add the missing tool to the authority manifest with its minimum required scope.
